user.title: Govee API key
user.description: In the Govee Home app, go to Settings and choose Apply for API Key. Govee emails the key to you.

devices.title: Choose lights
devices.description: Pick the lights to control through the Govee cloud. Leave out lights you already control locally (for example with Govee lights local).

reauth_confirm.title: Govee API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Govee no longer accepts the stored API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Govee API. Try again later.
error.wrong_account: This key belongs to a Govee account without the lights you set up.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.
abort.no_lights: No lights were found on this Govee account.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Govee API. Try again later.
